mentions.name: Articulation Sites
mentions.description: A website builder created as the successor to Weebly by former Weebly founding engineers, offering a great, reliable alternative platform that Weebly users can depend on.
mentions.problem: The Weebly brand is in decline under Square's ownership, leaving its users without a dependable platform.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're working on the successor to Weebly, with https://www.articulationsites.com. My partner and I were founding engineers at Weebly. It's clear that the brand is in decline at the hands of Square, and it drives us every day to make a great alternative that Weebly users can rely on.
